claim: Repo claims a time-scale request system: the pause menu OnActivate (0x141961068) pushes a SimulationTimeScale request via 0x14046bdec, with a time-scale manager at 0x1426ffb08+0x70, and that the game does not pause on focus loss.
evidence: GameOffsets.h:70 "The real sim-freeze is the SimulationTimeScale request the pause menu's OnActivate (FUN_141961068) pushes"
game_build_compatibility: UNKNOWN: repo records no game version, Steam buildid, exe hash or build check; it only states a ~112 MB x64 Steam exe with SteamStub v3.1 + Denuvo (docs/reverse-engineering.md:12,21-29). Our exe is 117732784 bytes (~112.3 MiB), consistent but not proof of 1.0.8874.0 / build 3095001. Offsets are hardcoded file RVAs (no pattern scan, no version gate), so any mismatch with 1.0.8874.0 would silently hook wrong code.
verification_method: Static read of repo comments; author marks parts unverified/open TODO.
limitations: Unresolved by the author. Relevant to co-op because pause/time-scale (menus, slow-mo, executions) must be synchronized or suppressed across players.
next_experiment: Statically locate 'SimulationTimeScale' string xrefs in our exe.
